paragraphs.text: Mizzix of the Izmagnus is a goblin from Ravnica , who works as a galvanic blastseeker in the Izzet League .

She began her career as a lowly attendant. Through a combination of natural talent, calculated political moves and fortunate accidents she has risen to the highest position in the Izzet League's court, occupying a seat of the Izmagnus .
